observation.visible_scene: A single leafless tree is silhouetted at the center of a low, dark land horizon beneath a smooth twilight sky that fades from deep blue at the top to pale near the horizon and is dotted with stars. A still body of water fills the lower half of the frame and mirrors the tree. The tree, sky, and horizon stay fixed throughout the excerpt.
visible_changes: The water surface carries gentle, continuous small ripples, visible as subtle, frame-to-frame wobble and distortion of the tree's reflection (the reflected branches shift shape slightly over time).
A faint bright glint/streak appears on the right side of the water near the reflection around t=0.40s (frame 7), persists through roughly t=0.87s (frame 14), then fades.
A faint bright spot appears on the left side of the water around t=1.13s (frame 18), persists through roughly t=1.40s (frame 22), then fades.
No translation, scaling, or deformation of the tree itself is observed; the tree silhouette remains in the same position and size.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause of the water ripples and the two transient light glints (e.g., wind, a passing object, or moving reflected light) is not shown.
Whether the ripple/glint activity began before the first frame or continues after the last frame is unknown.
uncertain_details: It is uncertain whether the right and left bright marks are expanding ripples, moving specular glints, or separate small disturbances.
A possible very slight vertical shift in framing near the end of the segment is too subtle to confirm as camera motion versus reflection distortion, so camera movement is treated as uncertain.
The exact timing and shape of individual ripple cycles cannot be resolved from the sampled frames.
